verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server that lets MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) connect to a user's agent memory, with enterprise SSO support, and this is independently confirmed by a live probe of the docs URL. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice (community evidence only discusses Graphiti/memory quality generally, not the MCP server specifically).
